units.source_text: 大概不到开市的时间，这条街上行人出奇的稀少。

en.t: It was probably still before the market opened, and there were strangely few pedestrians on this street.
The sound of my wooden clogs was especially harsh.

units.source_text: 老鸨母招呼的早调声，听起来犹如充溢在梅雨时的低垂而潮湿的空气之中。

en.t: The madam's morning calls sounded as though they were filling the low, damp air of the rainy season.

units.source_text: 我的脚趾紧紧地夹住松了的木屣带，暗自想道：

en.t: My toes gripped the loosened thong of my wooden sandal tightly, and I thought to myself:

units.source_text: 停战后从不动山山顶上眺望着万家灯火中，确实也包括这条街的灯火。

en.t: Among the countless lights I had looked out over from the summit of Mount Fudo after the war's end, the lights of this street had certainly been included too.
